body.statement: Chen--Darwiche Theorem 15 states that, for an \(F\)-identifiability tuple \(\langle G,V,C_V,W\rangle\), functionally eliminating any set of observed functional variables that are neither treatments nor outcomes, are separable from \(C_V\), and have observed parents preserves \(F\)-identifiability of the causal effect of \(X\) on \(Y\).

attestation.note: Scope checked against Theorem 15 in the cited source.
